annotations.title: 8004 NONCE: verify a piece (chain + independent recompute)

description: THE KEYSTONE. Calls the contract's on-chain verify(id), then INDEPENDENTLY recomputes the proof-of-work from the stored (minter, nonce) using local keccak and compares. Two machines, one truth. Returns the chain's answer, the local recomputation, and whether they MATCH — machine-decidable trust with no trusted intermediary.
